## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on that afternoon's US CPI release and whether the Fed will hike rates the following week. The market prices in a hike at over 70% probability, but the guest points out that PCE is trending lower and that the Fed has rarely hiked in September of a midterm-election year. Hosts and guest note that Stockholm and global equities have stayed resilient despite oil at about $110 and US yields near 5%, and they expect a fairly good autumn with a possible break in 2027. No individual stocks are discussed. The only companies named appear in a sponsor segment and a betting-quiz ad.
